title: [DEV] Crash on trying to enter minutes in TT window
symptom: App crash when trying to enter duration in temp target dialog. Pressing the minutes field causes keyboard to pop up and app crashes. Also occurs in bolus assistant when numeric keyboard is used.
cause: NullPointerException in DigitsKeyListenerWithComma.filter due to Android java lib not properly marked @Nullable.
fix: Update to the commit that fixes the @Nullable annotation issue.
evidence_quote: try to update Androd java lib was not properly marked @Nullable
